working_title: Executability Engagement in School-Security Guidance: A Preregistered Documentary Audit
primary_objective: Audit documentary engagement with protective-action executability in authoritative school-security and emergency-preparedness guidance
research_questions: RQ1-RQ4 as in manuscript (ladder depth; locus; setting differentiation; benchmark contrast)
theoretical_scope: Protective-action executability / executability engagement (Branch A); demand-source rules; locus
excluded_scope: Threat detectability as main model; real-world preparedness; effectiveness; combined inclusive-security score; field validation of SLAPA
method: Preregistered documentary content analysis; PE coding; ladder; locus; benchmarks
required_data: Authoritative L0/L1 corpus after freeze; complete pilot including benchmark calibration
inputs: Codebook; protocol; candidate frame; pilot Phase A (protocol-development only)
likely_journal_family: Safety Science / human factors / emergency management
claims_permitted: Documentary engagement claims bounded to audited corpus
claims_prohibited: Actual preparedness; effectiveness; attack prevention; school-type vulnerability ranks; validated field instrument
unresolved_decisions: Complete pilot Phase B (CF-02); corpus freeze; prereg ID; full coding; Results

working_title: School Lone-Actor Preparedness Assessment (SLAPA): Instrument Architecture and Content Validation
primary_objective: Specify multidimensional organisational preparedness architecture and establish content validity / early feasibility
research_questions: What domains and evidence types should an organisational instrument cover to be sensitive to functional needs and executability without collapsing to a single score?
theoretical_scope: Organisational preparedness multi-domain model informed by RP-P1 and theory; Domain B reserved but not validated
excluded_scope: Psychometric field validation; incidence prediction; intervention efficacy; questionnaire item finalisation as published scale
method: Structured synthesis of RP-P1; expert review/Delphi; content-validity indices; cognitive interviews; optional small feasibility pilot
required_data: RP-P1 empirical under-specification map; expert panel; draft domain definitions
outputs: SLAPA architecture v1; content-validity evidence; cognitive-interview report; claims-bounded manual draft
likely_journal_family: Safety Science / IJDRR / school safety journals
claims_prohibited: Validated instrument; predicts/prevents attacks; Layer-5 outcomes; single total preparedness rank
unresolved_decisions: Exact item set; sampling frame for experts; ethics for cognitive interviews

working_title: Field Validation of SLAPA in Inclusive and Special Education Settings
primary_objective: Evaluate reliability and structural/construct validity of SLAPA organisational measures in educational centres
research_questions: Does SLAPA yield reliable domain profiles and interpretable between-setting differences without stigmatising school types?
theoretical_scope: Measurement of organisational adoption capability and exercised performance (Layers 2-4)
excluded_scope: Layer-5 effectiveness; attack prediction; deficit ranking of pupils or school types
method: Survey/organisational audit; cognitive follow-up as needed; reliability; factor/Rasch as design allows; invariance/group comparison safeguards
required_data: Centre-level responses; optional document review; optional exercise artefacts
inputs: RP-P2 instrument package; ethics approvals; school access
outputs: Validity/reliability evidence; domain profiles; practice implications bounded by claims policy
studies_enabled: Intervention studies; practice manual; policy briefs
claims_prohibited: Inherent safety ranking of school types; attack prevention; documentary-only readiness
unresolved_decisions: Sample size; country context; funding; exact analytic model

working_title: Threat Detectability and False-Positive Safeguards in School Security Doctrine and Practice
primary_objective: Analyse detectability/BTAM/false-positive safeguards as theoretically independent from demand-capability executability
research_questions: How does doctrine (and later practice) specify reporting triage baseline interpretation specialist participation and FP safeguards?
theoretical_scope: Organisational sensing and threat detectability; FP and disability/neurodiversity safeguards
excluded_scope: Demand-capability fit for detection; endorsement of surveillance expansion; pupil dangerousness scoring
method: Documentary module (Family F) and/or later field Domain B module; companion to RP-P1 not merged
required_data: BTAM-relevant corpus subset; later field items if pursued
inputs: RP-P1 corpus/infra; Branch B protocol reservation
outputs: Detectability doctrine map; Domain B field module candidate; ethical safeguards articulation
dependencies: Shares infra with RP-P1; theoretically independent of RP-P1 model; field module may follow RP-P2
studies_enabled: Policy safeguards; SLAPA Domain B field use
likely_journal_family: Threat assessment / policing / Safety Science companion
claims_permitted: Independent detectability engagement claims; FP safeguard presence/absence in docs or orgs
claims_prohibited: More reporting equals more safety; disability as threat proxy; merged E+F score
unresolved_decisions: Whether doc-first or field-first sequencing; capacity relative to RP-P2/P3
